voice_style.butterscotch: Warm, slow, cozy old dragon grandpa telling a bedtime story: soft and round, a gentle low purr-rumble, smiling, a little whispery, a yawn hiding in some lines, delighted chuckles, bright on exclamations. Never booming, never growly, never a roar. Quick delivery: each line fits in about 2-2.5 seconds.
voice_style.elevenlabs: A gentle, older male storyteller voice (warm, soft, slightly husky - a kindly grandpa, not a deep booming one). Stability ~40%, Similarity ~75%, Style ~30%, Speed 1.05-1.1.
voice_style.openai_tts: gpt-4o-mini-tts with voice 'ballad' or 'cedar' (or 'ash'; avoid 'onyx', too deep), the Butterscotch prompt as instructions. Disclose the AI voice on the parent sign.
voice_style.sidekick: Snuffwick is not a separate actor and is mostly sound effects (giggle, squeak, 'pfft'). His only 2 lines (attract_call_8, circle_2) are recorded in Butterscotch's voice; the builder pitches them up 5 semitones at 1.15x speed (voice fx "smudge" - the effect kept its Moonshards name).

_asset_guide.why_stills: Butterscotch floating like a balloon and changing expressions, Snuffwick tiptoeing in with his rubber chicken, the hoard coin spinning, the Dragon Gem rising out of the Wakestone, the Golden Star climbing
_asset_guide.live_magic: glows in each kid's crystal colour, sparkles, the Hoard Lantern's growing glow, the numbers and words
_asset_guide.anchor_note: The Hoard Lantern's glow is placed by the words key `meter.pos` ("x,y,radius" in screen pixels, default 150,110,70): once `bg_cave` exists, open `assets/previews/` and, if the painted lantern isn't there, change `meter.pos` (or `/oracle/captions.ini` [meter] pos on the card).
_asset_guide.guardrails: Butterscotch is CARAMEL / toffee brown, never gold: gold is only for the Golden Star (and its starburst); silver is the hoard coin; red is only the Dragon Gem.
_asset_guide.order: Day 1 Butterscotch (base + sleep, peek, delight, surprise) · Day 2 Butterscotch giggle + puff, Snuffwick (base + rubber chicken) and the four props · Day 3 the three backgrounds (`bg_cave` first: check where the lantern landed) · Day 4+ the nice-to-haves.
printables: **Bowl signs** — print `prop_coin` (silver circle bowl: HOARD COIN, also the GOBLIN TRICK bowl), `prop_gem` (red triangle bowl: DRAGON GEM) and `prop_star` (gold star, held by the host: GOLDEN STAR) so the bowls match the screen picture-for-picture. Light each sign with a battery LED puck.
**Parent sign** — `print_keyart` with the sign text from STORY.md §13. Keep the line *"Butterscotch's voice is AI-generated."* (OpenAI's and ElevenLabs' terms ask you to disclose AI voices.)

Generous plain dark space at the top and the bottom for sign text. Dark midnight-indigo cave background. Cute storybook 3D-painted style like a modern family animated film; soft rounded chunky shapes; glossy candy-like materials; smooth clean shading; gentle rim light; no grain, no fine texture, no mist, no bokeh, no tiny stars, no text, no letters, no watermark. Spooky-cute and cozy, never scary.

clips.notes: Butterscotch dozes (balloon bob) and peeks one eye open; Snuffwick tiptoes in from the right, giggles (sfx 'munch' at 5.4 s) and scampers off. The device draws the Hoard Lantern's glow (upper-left), the spark counter and the place-crystal hints.
After the lantern is lit: the cave glows; Butterscotch dozes happily; Snuffwick, now the Official Prankster, scampers by hugging his glowing sock (the 2027 tease).
One eye pops open, then surprise. The device draws the beam of crystal-coloured light into his chest (the anchor) and the colour name.

One colour variant per crystal colour, awaken_1..awaken_3 (the crystal tinted with color.N_hex: 1 Dragonberry, 2 Starfrost, 3 Rainbow Fizz), rises from the Wakestone; Butterscotch floats down (surprise), then beams (his chest glow starts at 3.0 s). The device adds sparkles + the meter.
One visual for every rank (except the Wizard hat below); the device draws the rank name and the meter.
Rank 5 Wizard: 'Here's your hat!' - a little wizard hat pops out of Butterscotch's paws and twirls up beside him (upper right; it never lands on the device-drawn crystal).
The device draws the tap prompt (TAP! TAP!; the button prompt when a plinth button is fitted), the fill bar and sparkles; his chest glow swells with each tap on the window.

Gag 1 Rubber Chicken: Snuffwick zips in hugging a squeaky rubber chicken, Butterscotch pulls a silly face, poof - it's a hoard coin! Snuffwick giggles off. (Device: a white poof at about (615, 230) at 1.1 s.)

Gag 2 Hiccup Bubbles: Snuffwick pops up behind Butterscotch's shoulder and tickles his nose with a feather; hic! hic! - bubbles float up. (Device: sparkles in the kid's crystal colour from his mouth.)

Gag 3 Snuff-Out: Snuffwick tiptoes in, 'pfft!' - the cave goes dark (no bg = black; only his eyes blink, and the device's lantern sparks + Butterscotch's tummy glow stay on: the kids' light can't be snuffed), Butterscotch sneezes sparkles at 1.4 s and the lights pop back on; Snuffwick sneezes and scampers off.
HOARD COIN: the silver coin flips up out of his paws and spins (upper right, clear of the lantern).
DRAGON GEM: the ruby triangle rises out of the Wakestone and turns once; Butterscotch gasps.
Variant 2 (with reveal_t2_2's line): the gem wobbles up and Butterscotch's gasp turns into a beam.
GOLDEN STAR: the gold rays turn slowly, the star rises and grows (no strobe); Butterscotch beams beside it.
Already played tonight: a 'shh' wink (one-eye peek until the wink still exists); the device shows tonight's result dimmed.
The dragon blessing: Butterscotch puffs his cheeks and blows a sparkly blessing bubble down to the kid (+1 spark for the lantern).
Unreadable crystal: a big yawn (the sleeping face until the yawn still exists).
He waves and floats up like a balloon (delighted face until the wave still exists).
Every 100th crystal: the device adds confetti in the crystal colours + the big station counter in the centre (so Butterscotch sits to the right).
3+ crystals in one group: the device orbits small crystals in the group's colours around Butterscotch; Snuffwick peeks in and sneezes at all that glow.
Keeper of the Hoard secret (about 1 visit in 3): a slow push-in on the wink - the only close-up.

The Hoard Lantern blazes (the lit cave fades in); Snuffwick, dazzled, sneezes, then smiles shyly - invited to the feast as Official Prankster - and scampers off hugging his glowing sock (2027 stinger).
Every Halloween he wakes under the lit lantern to share the hoard.
Snuffwick climbs the candy pile under the lantern, 'pfft!' - the lit cave goes dark (the device does not draw the lantern glow in this part).
Lore: the Candlewizards' Moonstone cracked into the crystals.
The crystal on the Wakestone changes through every crystal colour (Dragonberry, Starfrost, Rainbow Fizz).
Sparks light the lantern (the lit cave fades in) and Butterscotch wakes up delighted. The device draws tonight's lantern glow over it (meter.on).
The cliffhanger: Snuffwick scampers past hugging a lumpy sock that glows gold inside.

sfx.desc: Crystal placed: a soft whoosh up into a warm glass chime (light flying into Butterscotch's tummy).
sfx._search: magic whoosh chime, glass chime rise

sfx.desc: A new crystal wakes: rising magical shimmer, twinkly harp glissando, warm and gentle.
sfx._search: magic shimmer, harp glissando, fairy sparkle

sfx.desc: Generic GOBLIN TRICK! sting: a playful cartoon boing / slide-whistle + a tiny goblin giggle (never a fail buzzer).
sfx._search: cartoon boing, slide whistle, small giggle

sfx.desc: Gag 1 Rubber Chicken (starts 0.65 s into the gag): two squeaky rubber-chicken squeaks, then a soft magic 'poof' + a coin 'ting' at about 0.5 s.
sfx._search: rubber chicken squeak, cartoon poof, coin ting

sfx.desc: Gag 2 Hiccup Bubbles: two cute 'hic!' hiccups, each with a soap-bubble pop.

Gag 3 Snuff-Out (starts 0.65 s into the gag): a tiny candle 'pfft' (the lights go out), a beat of quiet with a little goblin giggle, then a bright sparkly shimmer at about 0.75 s (the sneeze relights the cave; Butterscotch's voice says the 'CHOO').
sfx._search: candle snuff out, small giggle, magic sparkle burst

sfx.desc: HOARD COIN: a bright coin 'ting' + a twinkly two-chord chime, happy.
sfx._search: coin ting, twinkle chime, magic bell

sfx.desc: DRAGON GEM: a magical swirl + sparkle arpeggio, wondrous.
GOLDEN STAR: harp glissando + a soft warm gong (the host's cue to come over). No harsh brass.
sfx._search: harp glissando, soft gong, magical reveal

sfx.desc: Each tap on the window (or button press) during charge: a tiny bright blip (it repeats fast).
Only with a plinth button (config.ini button = yes; none in 2026): a friendly bloop when it's pressed with no crystal on the stone.
Charge meter full: a quick rising 'ding-ding-DING'.
sfx._search: level up ding, power up chime

sfx.desc: Sleepy crystal: a soft descending double-bloop with a tiny yawn feel, gentle (never an error buzz).
Soft airy whoosh for transitions (goodbye float-up, the blessing bubble, rank-ups).
Snuffwick in the attract loop (played ~5.4 s into each loop as he peeks in; the id stays 'munch' for the firmware): a tiny shy goblin giggle + a soft candle 'pfft'.
sfx._search: cute small giggle, candle blow out

sfx.desc: Milestone: a party-horn toot + a cheer + sparkles, kid-friendly.
The Hoard Lantern lights (finale): a warm 'whoomph' of a big lantern catching, swelling into a happy magical chord. Never a roar.
sfx._search: lantern whoosh ignite soft, magical swell, triumphant fairy chord

music.desc: Seamless 45-90 s loop: a gentle spooky-cute music-box / celesta lullaby with soft pizzicato and a cozy low bassoon, slow, warm, never scary. Quiet enough to talk over.
music._search: music box lullaby halloween, celesta spooky cute, cozy halloween loop

music.desc: The same lullaby in a brighter, happier feast-time arrangement for after the Hoard Lantern is lit.
